inflate — 3D occupancy op

• Data kinds: voxel → voxel

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.inflate(occupancy, radius, voxel_size=1.0) (to call the implementation directly, import occupancy; occupancy.inflate(occupancy, radius, voxel_size=1.0); from the registry, ops3d.get("inflate"))

Usage

A bool occupancy grid with the obstacles inflated by radius (in world units) — i.e. ESDF <= radius counts as occupied.

Safety margin for the planner: if a point robot avoids collisions on the inflated grid, a real robot of radius radius keeps its clearance from obstacles (configuration-space obstacle). The ESDF is the positive nearest-occupied distance outside, so ESDF<=radius captures "occupied (negative) ∪ free within radius of an obstacle". Increasing radius monotonically increases occupancy (the GT for downstream tests).

Raises ValueError for radius<0 or voxel_size<=0 (both validated up-front, before the radius==0 / empty-occupancy short-circuit — otherwise an invalid voxel_size slips through unchecked when esdf is never reached).
